title: Shah Waliullah Dehlawi
note: Foundational South Asian Islamic reformer whose works such as Hujjat Allah al-Baligha, Al-Fawz al-Kabir fi Usul al-Tafsir, and Izalat al-Khafa 'an Khilafat al-Khulafa shaped later Muslim political and reformist thought.
